name: Radio Community Directory
author: QUILL Team
description: Contributes a small community station directory to Quill Radio -- searchable in Find Stations AND browsable under Quillin Sources -- from this Quillin's own static list. The bundled reference for the radio.directory capability, including the browse trio.

directory_providers.description: Returns demo community stations from this Quillin's static list (no network): searchable in Find Stations, and browsable as a source under Quillin Sources with two categories and a play-time resolve step.
